{{Quote|P8-47 carrying urgent message // Message <nowiki>=</nowiki> sent by Nem'ro the Hutt // Mighty Nem'ro all powerful ruler of Jigunna.|translated=1|P8-47 addresses an Imperial-aligned individual|<ref name="SWTORDeath" />}}
'''P8-47''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The droid was owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]], who controlled the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Jiguuna]]. When Nem'ro's rival [[Voontara Fa'athra]] began moving [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Fa'athra clan|forces]] into Jiguuna, Nem'ro became enraged and sent the droid to the [[Poison Pit]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] to deliver a message that Nem'ro was offering a reward to any who would kill Fa'athra's men. The droid showed the message to an individual aligned with the Empire who agreed to take on the task and eliminated some of Fa'athra's men.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Cripple this coward's army and you will know the honor and rewards of serving the great and powerful Nem'ro the Hutt.|translated=1|Nem'ro offers a reward for those who kill his foes, in a message displayed by P8-47|<ref name="SWTORDeath" />}}
[[File:P8-47_message.png|thumb|left|200px|P8-47 displays a holographic message from Nem'ro the Hutt.]]
P8-47 was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Nem'ro's gang|owned]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTORDeath" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Nem'ro's rival [[Voontara Fa'athra]] sent [[Fa'athra clan|forces]] to wage war against [[Gender/Legends|him]] in the streets of [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="SWTORDeath" /> an industrial town on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] that Nem'ro controlled.<ref name="SWTORJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> Outraged, Nem'ro placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on all of Fa'athra's men in Jiguuna and recorded a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message advertising the reward and calling for anyone who heard it to eliminate them. Nem'ro then tasked P8-47 to deliver the message to everyone it could and threatened to have the droid destroyed and sent to the scrap heap if it failed in its task. P8-47 traveled to the [[Poison Pit]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in Jiguuna in order to deliver the message, although it dismissed some individuals who approached it, claiming it was on an important mission and so too busy to talk.<ref name="SWTORDeath" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
P8-47 successfully delivered the message to an individual in the Poison Pit who was aligned with the Empire. The individual agreed to defeat the thugs and left the cantina, [[Death/Legends|killing]] at least six of Fa'athra's men in the surrounding area. P8-47 was appreciative that the task was complete and Nem'ro was content with the result and rewarded the individual.<ref name="SWTORDeath" />
{{Endgame}}

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|P8-47 <nowiki>=</nowiki> relieved // Nem'ro <nowiki>=</nowiki> turn P8-47 into spare parts if message ignored // P8-47 <nowiki>=</nowiki> not ready for scrap heap.|translated=1|P8-47 expresses relief that an individual agreed to kill Fa'athra's men|<ref name="SWTORDeath" />}}
P8-47 described its master Nem'ro as all-powerful and considered the Hutt a dangerous individual to refuse. The droid claimed to be relieved when an individual agreed to kill Fa'athra's men for Nem'ro. P8-47 spoke in [[binary]] and was equipped with a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] capable of displaying [[Hologram/Legends|holographic messages]] with sound. It had a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] and brown and gray plating.<ref name="SWTORDeath" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Nem'ro <nowiki>=</nowiki> dangerous to refuse // Nem'ro <nowiki>=</nowiki> turn P8-47 into spare parts if message ignored // P8-47 <nowiki>=</nowiki> stay here for now.|translated=1|P8-47's dialogue if the player refuses to accept the quest|<ref name="SWTORDeath" />}}
P8-47 appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the mission "Death Mark: Fa'athra Gang". The mission is not part of any class storyline, and thus is optional. It is available only to members of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunter]] and [[Imperial Agent]] classes, as it takes place in their starting zone, Nal Hutta. There are no "[[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]" or "[[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]" options within the quest, and once the player has killed the thugs, the quest completes without them having to return to P8-47.<ref name="SWTORDeath" />
